# Banner

## Sources

| | |
|---|---|
| **Notion** | [Banner](https://www.notion.so/35f50ba3919d8121a8abdfd3bc8374f3) |
| **Figma page** | [Banner](https://www.figma.com/design/IgohaddARKIJHihXX0OE4Z/Gembox-Components?node-id=2372-113456) (`2372:113456`) |

### Build steps
1. Always load parent `gembox-design-system` first.
2. `get_metadata` with `fileKey` `IgohaddARKIJHihXX0OE4Z` and `nodeId` `2372:113456` — scan this page for the **main** component set (skip Deprecated).
3. `get_design_context` on that set for measurements and assets.

## Rules (from Notion)

Top-of-page must-see message. Severities: Info, Navy/Brand, Warning, Success, Danger. One per page; not for save/toast state. Padding 1rem; gaps 1.5rem; copy max ~45rem.

## Sources

| | |
|---|---|
| **Notion** | [Button](https://www.notion.so/21c50ba3919d801eb4e6cb0d7ff094e9) |
| **Figma page** | [Button](https://www.figma.com/design/IgohaddARKIJHihXX0OE4Z/Gembox-Components?node-id=49-2305) (`49:2305`) |

1. Always load parent `gembox-design-system` first.

## Rules (from Notion)

Styles compact|primary|secondary|tertiary; sizes hero|default|small; one icon max; loading = disabled + spinner from Figma; mobile stack full-width, primary nearest content.

=== FILE: .cursor/skills/gembox-catalog/SKILL.md ===
---
name: gembox-catalog
description: >-
  Lists Gembox Figma pages and topic skills. Use for "list" commands. Always load gembox-design-system first.
---

# Gembox catalog

**Canonical component list:** `figma-pages.json` (from Gembox Components Figma file scan).

## Always on

`gembox-design-system` — golden rule: zero exceptions; never build UI outside the design system.

## On demand

Each **Figma page** → `gembox-<slug>/` with **Notion** (if exists) + **Figma page URL**.

- `richness: notion` — richer rules from Notion
- `richness: figma-only` — build from Figma until Notion is written

## List command

Read `catalog.json` `entries`. Group by `category` (Core, Component, Forage Pattern, Documentation). Show slug, name, Notion URL, Figma page URL.
